title: The Edge I Did Not Choose

content.caption: A steep green slope runs down toward a flat teal sea under a pale sky, with a grey rock cluster and a mossy shelf in the lower left corner. The horizon is a thin pale line where the water meets the air.
content.opinion: The slope is too steep to be trusted and the sea is too far to be useful, but the rocks in the corner look like a fine place to claim later.
